news.headline: Butker made a 28-yard field-goal try in the second quarter, but he was limited to just one field-goal make for the third
news.detail: Butker made a 28-yard field-goal try in the second quarter, but he was limited to just one field-goal make for the third time over four contests this season. The kicker has gone 7-for-9 on field-goal attempts, including 0-for-2 from 50-plus yards, to this point in the 2026 campaign.
